item.text: {"summary":"The resolver and forecast trace are strong, but the model-prior treatment and small point-estimate discrepancy need clarification before publication.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"model_prior","severity":"blocking","summary":"No time-series or statistical model prior is used or explicitly ruled out.","actionRequested":"State why the short or preliminary series makes a formal model unsuitable, or report the model prior and how it informed the forecast."},{"rubricItem":"coherence","severity":"warning","summary":"The seasonal calculation gives 6.777089 million, while the ladder median and point estimate are 6.780 million without explaining the difference.","actionRequested":"Explain the approximately 0.003 million adjustment or rounding that connects the calculated prior to the final point estimate."}],"optionalSuggestions":["Briefly explain how reporting and policy uncertainty informed the chosen ladder width."]}
